name: Vortex
description: Anomalie erratique se déplaçant de manière imprévisible pour éviter les systèmes de ciblage conventionnels adverses.

loadout.armor_outfit: Formes instables entre plusieurs réalités. Membres se dupliquant en images fantômes. Couleurs impossibles. Texture glitch comme un fichier corrompu.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (enemy_with_highest) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Everyday working pose, natural stance — character shown in their normal operational state — Focused beam of nullification targeting the strongest enemy card

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Void Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — gaps where reality is missing

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Flat ambient light with subtle shadows, documentary-style natural lighting

camera.angle: eye-level direct portrait creating a sense of honest documentation

scenography.setting: Space where multiple realities overlap, buildings from different dimensions coexisting, sky showing conflicting celestial bodies and impossible colors
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Chromatic aberration splitting colors, spatial tears showing parallel dimensions, partial phasing between states, glitch artifacts and digital corruption, plus targeted suppression — beam locking onto highest-value enemy and reducing their power visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Anomalie erratique se déplaçant de manière imprévisible pour éviter les systèmes de ciblage conventionnels adverses.
card_metadata.faction_lore: L'Incursion Dissonante est l'ouverture de fissures entre les réalités, laissant passer des entités impossibles. Leur présence corrompt la structure même du réel.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Brushed steel frame with simple geometric pattern, no ornamentation, utilitarian finish
card_metadata.composition_directive: Medium close-up portrait (chest-up) showing character face and upper torso in their working environment
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
